notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
Changes:

[b]Rewards[/b]
[list]
[*]Tripled the amount gems received from battles
[*]You can now swap in uncommon cards after defeating normal, and rare+ cards on hard or higher
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*]Slightly reduced the scaling of mob damage past dungeon 1
[*]Reduced mob max move distance
[*]Slightly shortened the length of the first dungeon
[*]Dramatically shortened the length of the second dungeon
[/list]
